examples.name: Sample — a single-storey plan
paragraphs: Twelve labelled areas, eight of them with a printed size, and dimension lines on all four sides. The printed dimensions do not add up (32'-0", 40'-0" and 44'-0" under a 62'-0" span) and are copied as printed.

snippets.text: ```description Floor plan of a single-storey house.
